security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed expected BrowserAct API calls and one local script invocation. Most Markdown backtick and system-reconnaissance alerts are false positives. Document that keywords, locale settings, task identifiers, and results are sent to BrowserAct. Ask for user consent before running searches.
Keep invocation restricted to the packaged Python script, validate country, language, and numeric bounds, and pass arguments without shell interpolation.

content.user_title: Extract Google Image Metadata with BrowserAct
content.value_statement: Manual image result collection is slow and inconsistent. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to gather structured Google Images metadata by keyword and region.
actual_capabilities: Runs a bundled Python script that starts a BrowserAct Google Images workflow template.
Accepts keyword, country, language, scroll count, and maximum item parameters.
Polls BrowserAct task status for up to 300 seconds with timestamped logs.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment for authenticated BrowserAct requests.
Defines result fields for title, source, thumbnail, click-through link, and product flag.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct account and BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Sends search terms and task data to the BrowserAct API.
The current script returns before result retrieval after polling, so final data may not print.
Does not verify image licenses or usage rights.

use_cases.title: Compare Regional Image Results
use_cases.description: Collect localized Google Images metadata for trend reviews across supported countries and languages.

use_cases.title: Gather Visual References
use_cases.description: Find titles, sources, thumbnails, and links for mood boards and creative research.

use_cases.title: Track Product Search Presence
use_cases.description: Review product-style image results and source domains for competitor monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Search One Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search with a narrow keyword.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to search Google Images for modern office chairs in the US, in English, with a small result limit.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Local Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to collect image metadata for electric scooter in France and Japan. Summarize source patterns and title themes.

prompt_templates.title: Build Competitor Visual Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill for the keywords brand sneakers with moderate scrolling. Group results by source, product flag, and click-through link.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor Regional Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to run localized searches for a keyword list across supported countries. Return recurring sources, titles, and thumbnail patterns.

output_examples.input: Search running shoes in the US, English, with a result limit of 20.
output: A concise list of image result titles and source sites.
Thumbnail links and click-through links for each visible result.
Notes on product-style results and repeated source domains.

output_examples.input: Compare minimalist desk lamps in France and Japan.
output: A regional comparison of common source sites and title language.
A short summary of visual themes that appear in each region.
Links to representative result pages and thumbnail references.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in an environment variable or secret manager.
Use specific keywords, supported locales, and modest result limits.
Check source pages and licensing before using any image asset.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into shared chats or logs.
Do not assume thumbnails or source images are licensed for reuse.
Do not run broad, high-volume searches without user approval and cost checks.

faq.question: Do I need a BrowserAct API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The script requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to authenticate BrowserAct workflow requests.

faq.question: Does this download full image files?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed for metadata, thumbnails, source names, and click-through links.

faq.question: Which regions and languages are supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists supported country and language values in SKILL.md, including US, France, Japan, English, French, and Japanese.

faq.question: Is data sent to an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. Search parameters and task data are sent to BrowserAct to run the Google Images workflow.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when script execution is available.

faq.question: What should I do if authorization fails?
faq.answer: Refresh the BrowserAct key and set it in a private environment variable or secret store.
